name: 3DConsoleBridge-AR
author: NTM-3D
description:
Play 3D console games on AR glasses like XREAL.
1. A standalone DirectX 11 app. No ReShade or ShaderGlass needed.
2. Takes Frame Packing, Half SBS or Half TAB and gives Full SBS.
3. Keys: 1 = bypass, 2 = overlay, ESC = stop capture.
4. Needs AR glasses with Full SBS.
5. Needs a patched MS2130 or MS2130S capture card. The 3DConsoleBridge card shows how.
